howToPlay.zh: 点一下木鱼，功德加一。连敲三下之后开始念经，一敲一字：南无阿弥陀佛；停顿太久就要重新起板。键盘：先选中游戏画面，再按空格或回车。左右拖动或按方向键可以转动木鱼。声音在「选项」里调整。
howToPlay.en: Tap or click the wooden fish to earn merit. After three knocks it starts chanting Namo Amitabha (南无阿弥陀佛), one syllable per strike; pause too long and it warms up again. Keyboard: focus the game, then press Space or Enter. Drag sideways or use the arrow keys to turn it. Sound is in Options.
